sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Click 4 cross cells and track all HUD bars
cross_cells = [(50, 30), (55, 25), (55, 35), (60, 30)]

def get_hud():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    hud = {}
    for n in seg:
        b = n['boundary']
        if b:
            rmin = min(p[0] for p in b)
            if 16 <= rmin <= 24 and n['pixels'] <= 100:
                cmin = min(p[1] for p in b)
                hud[(n['color'], cmin)] = n['pixels']
    return hud

print(f"Initial HUD: {get_hud()}")

for i, (r, c) in enumerate(cross_cells):
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c}])
    hud = get_hud()
    print(f"After click {i+1} ({r},{c}): {hud}")
    if result.get('game_over') or result.get('level_completed'):
        print(f"Game state: game_over={result.get('game_over')}, level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
